description: palate — SessionStart first reads back hand edits to TASTE.md (added or reworded lines become your stated taste, deleted lines are forgotten and stay restorable with palate restore; a risky edit is held until palate taste --accept-edits), replays any model_edits.json state left from a prior run, injects the budgeted profile (the same body as TASTE.md, grouped by category and filled up to the token_budgets.prewarm_session budget; rows that did not qualify or did not fit stay in the ledger and are listed by palate taste --cut), and posts a notice of what entered or left the profile since the previous session (systemMessage), with an extra line when the background profile clean-up failed or was skipped; when an LLM gateway is configured — and distill.mode is not off and the cwd is not under distill.skip_dirs — it also fires one detached, lock-guarded child that learns from the just-closed transcript and then, once consolidate.every_events new events have landed, runs the batched dream pass (consolidation) in the same process (with no transcript, a due pass fires alone). UserPromptSubmit first reads back TASTE.md edits, then walks model_edits.json — a snapshot that drifted from disk since Stop can only be a hand-edit, so it is counted and cleared (the verbatim user_diff learn path is retired; the same edit is distilled from the transcript) — then, with no LLM gateway configured, captures an "I prefer …" clause as a STATED preference (behind the same secret/injection scanner as the CLI), announces what changed since the last notice (systemMessage: "palate: since your last prompt — profile +N −M; ledger: learned N …") while handing the model only the rows that entered the profile as a palate-learned additionalContext block, and injects a goal-scope prewarm block only when token_budgets.prewarm_goal is above 0 (off by default). PostToolUse (Edit|Write) snapshots the edited file (hash + 4KB bound) so a later hand-edit can be diffed. Stop re-baselines every snapshot to disk (the assistant still owns the turn, so drift here is its own sed/python edit, never the user's) and — with an LLM gateway configured — fires the detached distiller pass (learn only; the dream pass never rides on Stop). PreCompact writes a recovery prewarm block to state/recovery.md under the Palate home (~/.claude/palate by default, PALATE_HOME to override, or a repo's legacy .palate/). Every write re-renders the home's TASTE.md on exit, under a lock. Every handler degrades to empty output on error; hooks never fail the session.
